cues.en: Airborne allergens can cause symptoms, and you can reduce the amount of airborne allergens in your house by using filtration systems.
cues.zh: 空气中的过敏原会引发症状，使用过滤系统可以减少家中空气中的过敏原。

cues.en: There's a whole array of filtration systems that can be used, from furnace filters that go on the main furnace blower
cues.zh: 可用的过滤系统种类很多，从安装在主炉风机上的炉滤网

cues.en: to systems that you can use in a room.
cues.zh: 到室内使用的系统都有。

cues.en: They range from a $100
cues.zh: 价格从100美元
到800美元

cues.en: for the high end systems.
cues.zh: 的高端系统不等。

cues.en: And today, I'd like to show you the high end system and then also show you a homemade system that should work fairly well at home, for a fraction of the cost.
cues.zh: 今天，我想给大家展示高端系统，然后再展示一个自制系统，它在家中使用效果应该相当不错，成本却只是零头。

cues.en: This high end system,
cues.zh: 这个高端系统，

cues.en: that's been on loan to us from Ann Arbor Vacuum,
cues.zh: 是从Ann Arbor Vacuum借给我们的，

cues.en: is an $800 system that will filter virtually every particle out of the air. This particle counter is measuring particles that are point three microns in size, and it samples every six seconds. With a system like this,
cues.zh: 是一套800美元的系统，几乎能过滤掉空气中的每一个颗粒。这个粒子计数器测量的是0.3微米大小的颗粒，每六秒采样一次。有了这样的系统，

cues.en: you can filter out the particles
cues.zh: 你就能过滤掉这些颗粒，

cues.en: and thereby
cues.zh: 从而

cues.en: reduce the allergy symptoms.
cues.zh: 减轻过敏症状。

cues.en: So you can see we started off, I believe it was about 400,000
cues.zh: 可以看到，我们开始时，我记得大约是40万

cues.en: particles,
cues.zh: 个颗粒，

cues.en: and with this
cues.zh: 用这个

cues.en: counting system, we can see that it goes down
cues.zh: 计数系统，可以看到它降到了

cues.en: to essentially zero after a few seconds, after a few measurements.
cues.zh: 基本为零，几秒钟、几次测量之后就降下来了。

cues.en: And now you can see we're 400 and down to zero. This is an incredibly effective high efficiency particulate air filter or HEPA filter.
cues.zh: 现在可以看到，我们从400降到零。这是一款极为高效的高效微粒空气过滤器，也就是HEPA过滤器。

cues.en: And you can see that it'll scrub the air from about 400,000
cues.zh: 可以看到，它能把空气中大约每立方英尺40万

cues.en: particles per cubic foot down to zero particles per cubic foot.
cues.zh: 个颗粒净化到每立方英尺零个颗粒。

cues.en: You've seen the high end filter system now and what it can do. It's incredibly powerful, but not everyone can afford a 6 or $800 HEPA system. So there is something that you can do to filter your air in a in a bedroom, for instance. And this is something that you can put together with pieces from your hardware store. And what I've got here is about a fifth... 12 to $15 20 inch box fan and a HEPA filter that you can buy for a furnace. So this is a 20 by 20 inch HEPA filter, and it's important that you recognize that it comes in different levels of filtration. So a MERV 13 filter is a very highly rated filter that'll get a lot of very small, those 0.3 micron particles out of the air.
cues.zh: 你已经看过高端过滤系统以及它的效果了。它非常强大，但不是每个人都买得起 600 或 800 美元的 HEPA 系统。所以，比如在卧室里过滤空气，你还是有办法可做的。而且这个办法可以用五金店里的零件拼出来。我这儿有一个大约 12 到 15 美元的 20 英寸箱式风扇，还有你能买到的炉用 HEPA 过滤器。这是一个 20 x 20 英寸的 HEPA 过滤器，重要的是你要知道它有不同过滤等级。MERV 13 是一种评级很高的过滤器，能去除空气中大量很小的 0.3 微米颗粒。

cues.en: So this can simply be done by putting the filter in front of the box fan so the air is blowing through the filter.
cues.zh: 做法很简单，把过滤器放在箱式风扇前面，让空气吹过过滤器就行。

cues.en: And I'll just tape this filter here. You can see there's a direction for the airflow marked on the side of the filters. You'll see if you look at yours carefully.
cues.zh: 我就把过滤器粘在这里。你能看到过滤器侧面标了气流方向。仔细看你的过滤器就能看到。

cues.en: And now I'll take the same counter and count the particles
cues.zh: 现在我用同一个计数器来数颗粒

cues.en: coming through the system.
cues.zh: 也就是通过这套系统的颗粒。

cues.en: So our ambient count again is about 400,000,
cues.zh: 所以环境计数还是大约 400,000，

cues.en: and I'll turn the fan on
cues.zh: 然后我打开风扇

cues.en: and count the particles, and we'll see how they drop.
cues.zh: 再数颗粒，看看它们怎么下降。

cues.en: Typically, this MERF filter will cause about a 90% reduction in those small
cues.zh: 通常，这种 MERV 过滤器会让那些小的

cues.en: point three micron particles.
cues.zh: 0.3 微米颗粒减少约 90%。

cues.en: It measures every six seconds,
cues.zh: 它每六秒测量一次，

cues.en: and you can see I've gone down from 400,000
cues.zh: 可以看到，我从 400,000 降到了

cues.en: and it'll probably hover around that point.
cues.zh: 而且可能会在这个数值附近徘徊。

cues.en: So this $30...
cues.zh: 所以这个 30 美元……

cues.en: 25, $30 system is filtering
cues.zh: 25、30 美元的系统能过滤掉

cues.en: of the particles out of the air.
cues.zh: 空气中的颗粒物。

cues.en: You'll probably want to put something like this in a bedroom, for instance, where you sleep and spend a good part of your day to filter those particles out of the air.
cues.zh: 比如，你大概会想在家里放一个这样的东西，放在你睡觉、一天中大部分时间都待着的卧室里，把空气中的那些颗粒物过滤掉。

cues.en: If you want, you can put them in other areas of the house as well.
cues.zh: 如果你愿意，也可以把它们放在家里其他区域。
